blocks.text: Threering carries three unlike pieces around one knot. Its compact form recalls shared support without claiming that any three-part object represents the entire Codex or the whole history of the world.
Three unequal terracotta, teal and ivory ceramic rings woven together around a suspended plum knot.
One-shot use: The interlocked rings separate widely and their center knot unwinds into an extended ribbon. The game performs the final fade.

26 silver. Digestion / Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +8; Energy +8; Cleanliness +8. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.
